tools.name: action_company_get
tools.description: Retrieve hiring history snapshot and active jobs list for a specific hiring company.

tools.name: action_digest_subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe to the weekly newsletter digest of new marketing manager roles.

tools.name: action_job_get
tools.description: Fetch details of a single job opening.

tools.name: action_jobs_search
tools.description: Search and browse active marketing manager jobs.

tools.name: action_market_research_get
tools.description: Fetch live macro hiring signals and trends from the marketing job market.

tools.name: action_salary_insights_get
tools.description: Fetch live marketing manager salary statistics and transparency trends.

tools.name: action_saved_job_add
tools.description: Save a job opening to the user's account saved-items.

tools.name: get_research_trackers
tools.description: Return public research tracker data, including latest metrics, monthly trends, latest snapshot JSON, page URLs, and CSV export URLs.

report.description: Optional research tracker key. Omit to return all trackers.

tools.name: get_site_context
tools.description: Return public Marketing Manager Jobs site context: stats, taxonomy, routes, recent jobs, and citation guidance.

tools.name: search_marketing_jobs
tools.description: Search public active marketing manager-level jobs. Optional filters: q, role, location, level, remote, salary, skill, limit.

q.description: Free-text search across title, company, and description.

role.description: Role slug, such as marketing-manager, growth-marketing-manager, seo-manager, or product-marketing-manager.

location.description: Location slug, such as remote, united-states, europe, or san-francisco.

level.description: Level slug: internship, entry-level, mid-level, senior, or leadership.

remote.description: True to return remote jobs only.

salary.description: True to return salary-transparent jobs only.

skill.description: Skill slug, such as hubspot, sql, lifecycle-marketing, or product-marketing.

tools.name: subscribe_to_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribe to the free weekly marketing jobs digest email. Provide your email and optional filters.

role.description: Optional role focus slug, e.g. marketing-manager.
